content: Headless offscreen Vulkan rendering (no swapchain/window) follows the same render-pass model as windowed rendering minus presentation: create a VkRenderPass with color (and optional depth) attachments backed by manually-allocated VkImage/VkImageView (not swapchain images), a VkFramebuffer wrapping those attachments, then record vkCmdBeginRenderPass/vkCmdBindPipeline/vkCmdBindVertexBuffers/vkCmdDraw/vkCmdEndRenderPass into a command buffer and submit to a graphics queue with a fence. Readback requires copying the color attachment (device-local, optimal tiling) to a host-visible linear buffer via vkCmdCopyImageToBuffer (with an image layout transition to TRANSFER_SRC_OPTIMAL) before mapping and reading pixels. Sascha Willems' offscreen example is the reference implementation for this pattern.
